The following chunk calculates the date that is 30 days from today:

```{webr}
#| caption: Arithmetic with days and dates
#| persist: true
#| min-lines: 3
Sys.Date() + 30
```

Modify the chunk to create the collection which will calculate in one step the dates 30, 60, 90, and 120 days from today.

<!-- Opening answer: ctp-5ka -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}
## Answer

```{webr}
Sys.Date() + c(30, 60, 90, 120)
```
